title: Traditional Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A classic North African dish made with chicken, preserved lemons, and spices, slow-cooked in a clay tagine.

ingredients.name: Harsh spices
ingredients.notes: ground cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and ginger

instructions: Heat oil in a clay tagine or large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the turkey bacon and cook until browned, about 4 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the harsh spices, smoked paprika, preserved lemon, and chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with olives and fresh parsley.
